# NonUnitaryTopologicalInvariant

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Topological invariants (e.g., Chern numbers) generalized to non-unitary evolution, characterizing the topology of monitored quantum dynamics beyond closed systems. Provides measurable signatures for verifying topological phases in experimental TCC implementations, essential for validating quantum hardware.
